55cd604a-448b-4eb4-bd13-aa8c0f8143c9.text: As the OGs of the system, you probably won't want to leave Earth during your stay, but you're mostly welcome to leave whenever you want!

d8f50e6c-86a2-4b77-8309-7304355ce6bc.text: I knew it! Before you  continue, would you like to purchase this very special Earth OG Souvenir Hat? It is truly the PINNACLE of human craftsmanship!

d4a4adee-a368-44d7-9d5c-b8483a8ed53a.text: Fabulous! Enjoy your stay at Capitol OG.

4246b2de-dfd3-4de5-b2c0-f340026a8625.text: That makes sense, not everyone can pull off such fashion.
